title: Hierarchical Graph Memory for LLM Agents with Path-level Localization and Rewrite
title_zh: 面向 LLM Agents 的层次化图记忆：路径级定位与重写
abstract_en: Agents for long term reasoning require a memory that can be efficiently and effectively updated over time, as new facts and external feedback continue to arrive. Recently, graph memory has been adopted to offer structural organization for multi-hop retrieval and reasoning. However, existing methods store all memories in a flat graph, and accumulated historical memories can introduce irrelevant contexts and increase the cost of evidence selection during retrieval. Moreover, they typically update memory units independently, requiring repeated unit-wise rewrite to cover related changes. To address these issues, we propose HiGram, an evolving hierarchical graph memory framework with path-level localization and rewriting. Specifically, we first propose a hierarchical graph memory, which organizes the memory into coarse-to-fine architecture composed of upper-level nodes and MemoryUnits, thereby reducing the amount of irrelevant information during retrieval. We further propose MicroGraph-based path-level localization, which leverages query and update conditioned MicroGraphs to identify support subgraph and evidence path before rewrite. Finally, we propose a coordinated rewriting method that jointly revises intra-unit memory and inter-unit dependencies, enable valid dependency structures updating in the localized evidence path. Experiments on benchmarks for long-term conversational question answering and conflict-aware memory evaluation demonstrate that our method demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines in answer quality and token efficiency. Besides, our method improves answer accuracy and query-valid evidence selection under dynamic, static, and conditional conflicts.
abstract_zh: 长期推理型 Agents 需要一种能够随新事实和外部反馈持续到来而高效、有效更新的记忆机制。近期，graph memory 被用于为多跳检索与推理提供结构化组织，但现有方法通常将所有记忆存储在扁平图中，历史记忆累积后会引入无关上下文，并增加检索阶段证据选择成本。此外，它们往往独立更新各个记忆单元，面对相关联的变化时需要重复进行单元级重写。为解决这些问题，论文提出 HiGram：一种具备路径级定位与重写能力的演化式层次化图记忆框架。HiGram 首先构建由上层节点与 MemoryUnits 组成的粗到细层次化记忆结构，以减少检索时的无关信息；随后提出基于 MicroGraph 的路径级定位方法，利用由查询和更新条件化的 MicroGraphs，在重写前识别支持子图与证据路径；最后提出协同重写机制，联合修订单元内部记忆与单元间依赖关系，从而在局部证据路径中保持有效的依赖结构更新。在长期对话问答与冲突感知记忆评估基准上的实验表明，HiGram 在答案质量与 token 效率上显著优于基线，并在动态、静态和条件冲突场景下提升答案准确率与查询有效证据选择能力。
key_points_zh: 提出 HiGram，一种面向 LLM Agents 的演化式 hierarchical graph memory，用粗到细结构组织长期记忆，缓解扁平图中历史信息累积带来的无关上下文问题。
设计 MicroGraph-based path-level localization，通过查询与更新条件化的 MicroGraphs，在重写前定位支持子图和关键证据路径，降低证据选择成本。
提出 coordinated rewriting，联合更新 MemoryUnit 内部内容与 MemoryUnit 之间的依赖关系，使相关记忆变化能在局部路径上协同传播。
在长期对话问答和 conflict-aware memory evaluation 基准上，HiGram 相比基线显著提升回答质量与 token 效率。
在动态冲突、静态冲突和条件冲突场景中，该方法提升了答案准确率和 query-valid evidence selection 能力。

llm_assessment.comment: A solid evolving graph-memory system that improves retrieval and rewriting through hierarchical organization and path-level localization.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项扎实的演化图记忆系统，通过层次化组织和路径级定位改进检索与重写。
